Steps: 1. Rinse the wound gently under clean running water. 2. Apply antiseptic cream or lotion. 3. Cover with a sterile bandage or gauze.
Do: Clean with clean water, Apply antiseptic, Keep wound covered
Dont: Do NOT use cotton on wound, Do NOT ignore deep abrasions, Do NOT scratch the scab

Steps: 1. Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth for 15-20 minutes. 2. Elevate the bruised area above heart level. 3. Rest the injured part.
Do: Apply ice pack immediately, Elevate the limb, Rest the area
Dont: Do NOT apply ice directly to skin, Do NOT massage forcefully, Do NOT ignore if swelling increases

Steps: 1. Cool the burn under cool (not cold) running water for 10-20 minutes. 2. Cover with a clean non-fluffy material. 3. Seek medical attention for any serious burn.
Do: Cool with running water, Cover loosely with cling film, Seek hospital if large burn
Dont: Do NOT use ice or iced water, Do NOT apply butter or toothpaste, Do NOT burst blisters

Steps: 1. Apply direct pressure with a clean cloth or bandage. 2. Elevate the cut above heart level. 3. Clean with water, apply antiseptic, and cover with bandage.
Do: Apply firm pressure, Elevate the wound, Get stitches for deep cuts
Dont: Do NOT remove embedded objects, Do NOT use fluffy cotton, Shave surroundings if needed

Steps: 1. Soak the foot in warm salty water for 15 minutes. 2. Gently lift the nail edge and place cotton under it. 3. Keep clean and dry.
Do: Soak in warm water, Wear comfortable shoes, See a doctor if infected
Dont: Do NOT cut nails too short, Do NOT ignore signs of infection

Steps: 1. Control bleeding by pressing a clean cloth firmly on the wound. 2. Do not remove the cloth. 3. Go to emergency room.
Do: Apply firm steady pressure, Keep patient calm, Go to ER immediately
Dont: Do NOT probe the wound, Do NOT use a tourniquet unless severe

Steps: 1. Call 108 immediately. 2. Apply firm pressure around (not on) the wound. 3. Keep patient still and warm.
Do: Call 108 immediately, Keep still, Apply pressure around wound
Dont: Do NOT remove the object if embedded, Do NOT give food or water

Steps: 1. Immobilize the injured area. 2. Apply ice packs. 3. Keep still.
Dont: Do NOT try to realign bone, Do NOT move patient

Steps: 1. Sit upright and lean forward. 2. Pinch the soft part of the nose for 10-15 min. 3. Breathe through mouth.
Do: Lean forward, Pinch nose, Breathe through mouth
Dont: Do NOT lean back, Do NOT blow nose

Steps: 1. Keep still and calm. 2. Keep bitten area below heart level. 3. Get to hospital.
Do: Stillness, Medical help, Below heart level
Dont: Do NOT cut wound, Do NOT suck venom
